messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #4123 needs a quick review + merge coordination. Netlify preview is returning 500 for some font assets but local build looks fine. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — can reviewers take a look?
ci-bot: Netlify preview failed for branch docs/streaming-param (AssetIntegrityError). Logs: https://netlify.app/logs/preview/xyz (500 on /assets/fonts/*).
docs-bot: Reminder: merge window today 17:00 PST - prefer merges in that slot to avoid churn.
jen: I can review but won't be able to merge outside the scheduled window. If preview stays broken we should retrigger Netlify before the window. :eyes:
kevin: I'll review in ~30m. Quick Q: does this PR include the new streaming param example for the JS SDK? I saw an older snippet in the Go example too.
maria: Yes, it adds JS streaming + small Go snippet. I noticed the Netlify preview issue after pushing. Local MKDocs build is clean.
sam: Workaround that worked last time: create an empty commit on the branch to retrigger Netlify preview: `git commit --allow-empty -m "retrigger netlify preview" && git push`. Alternatively you can re-run deploy from Netlify UI.
jen: Good call. Also please add a one-liner in the PR description with a local preview command so reviewers can replicate: e.g., `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` or the Docker alternative.
kevin: Found a small nit in the Go snippet — old method name. I'll push a suggestion commit to the branch with the fix.
ci-bot: CI status: linter ✅, build ⚠️ (flaky asset hashing). Retry scheduled (attempt 2).
maria: If the retry fails, use Sam's empty-commit trick. Proposal: require preview green + CI pass before merge. If both OK, merge in the 17:00 PST window.
jen: That sounds safe. I can approve + merge once green. Please ping me in the channel.
sam: Minimal checklist for the PR (copy into PR description):
- Local preview command (how to run)
- Netlify preview link (post after rebuild)
- CI status screenshot or link
- QA steps (smoke test the SDK snippet)
- Reviewer approval and merge time
I'll paste that into the PR now.
kevin: Suggestion commit pushed (fixes Go method + adds missing import). Retrying local build now.
docs-bot: Note: when updating code samples, include `npm` and `curl` examples if possible — helps integrators.
ci-bot: Retry complete: build ✅, netlify preview redeploy triggered and currently building. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.netlify.app (pending).
maria: Thanks all. Once Netlify shows the preview URL and CI stays green, I'll merge at 17:00 PST. If anything blocks, comment here and we'll escalate.
kevin: Preview is green for me, fonts loading. Approved from my side. :thumbsup:
jen: I see the updated samples and tested the JS streaming snippet locally. Approving now.
maria: Merged at 17:02 PST (just inside the window) — PR closed. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
